lines: The states from immobile etc., wondrous, nearness to that world — should abandon, thus: not wonder; he thus who, by action even, or.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sthāvarādidaśāścitrāstatsalokasamīpatāḥ tyajecceti na citraṃ sa evaṃ yaḥ karmaṇāpi vā
